fusions.name: Binding Clause
fusions.desc: Silences one enemy within 7 tiles for 3 seconds and deals 8 damage, taking its next action away and knocking it back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Final Notice
fusions.desc: Hurls a link that deals 20 damage, up to 1.6 times that at maximum range. It can only be used on a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Signed Order
fusions.desc: Every ally within 6 tiles strikes 20% harder for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Standing Order
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner.
